require('../config/loggingConfig');\nconst ApproachDetector = require('./approach-detector');\nconst ProblemDetector = require('./problem-detector');\n\nclass LivingAIInterviewer {\n  constructor() {\n    this.supabase = createClient(\n      process.env.SUPABASE_URL || 'https://your-supabase-url.supabase.co',\n      process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY || 'your-service-role-key'\n    );\n    \n    // Active assessment sessions\n    this.activeSessions = new Map();\n    \n    // Code monitoring intervals\n    this.codeMonitoring = new Map();\n    \n    // Assessment state\n    this.assessmentState = new Map();\n    \n    // Socket IO instance for emitting messages\n    this.socketIO = null;\n    this.emitAndStore = null;\n    this.parameterDetectionConfig = parameterDetectionConfig;\n    this.aiAnalysisLocks = new Map(); // Prevent concurrent AI analysis per session\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Ensure session has required nested shapes to avoid runtime errors\n   */\n  ensureSessionShapes(session) {\n    if (!session) return;\n    if (!session.assessmentSession) session.assessmentSession = { retry_count: {}, assessment_state: { startTime: new session.conversationContext.recentMentions = new Map();\n    if (typeof session.conversationContext.conversationMood !== 'string') session.conversationContext.conversationMood = 'neutral';\n    if = {\n        communicationStyle: 'concise',\n        technicalDepth: 'surface',\n        responsePatterns: [],\n        interests: new Set(),\n        concerns: new Set(),\n        strengths: new Set(),\n        preferredExplanationStyle: 'unknown'\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Compute simple code stats: meaningful lines and boilerplate ratio\n   */\n  getCodeStats(code) {\n    const lines = (code || '').split(/\\r?\\n/);\n    const nonEmpty = lines.filter(l =&gt; l.trim().length &gt; 0);\n    const isComment = (l) =&gt; /^(\\s*\\/\\/|\\s*#|\\s*\\/\\*|\\s*\\*)/.test(l.trim());\n    const isImport = (l) =&gt; /^(\\s*import\\b|\\s*from\\b|\\s*using\\b|\\s*package\\b)/.test(l.trim());\n    const boilerplateLike = nonEmpty.filter(l =&gt; isComment(l) || isImport(l));\n    const meaningfulLines = nonEmpty.length - boilerplateLike.length;\n    const boilerplateRatio = nonEmpty.length === 0 ? 1 : boilerplateLike.length / nonEmpty.length;\n    const hasImplementationSignals = /(class\\s+\\w+|def\\s+\\w+\\(|function\\s+\\w+\\(|public\\s+\\w+\\(|=\\s*new\\s+|\\w+\\s*=\\s*\\w+|if\\s*\\(|for\\s*\\(|while\\s*\\()/i.test(code);\n    return { nonEmpty: nonEmpty.length, meaningfulLines, boilerplateRatio, hasImplementationSignals };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize parameter progress dynamically based on actual parameters\n   * Handles both old format (with ids) and new format (array indices)\n   */\n  initializeParameterProgress(parameters) {\n    const progress = {};\n    \n    if (!parameters || !Array.isArray(parameters)) {\n      console.log('⚠️ No parameters found, using empty progress');\n      return progress;\n    }\n    \n    parameters.forEach((param, index) =&gt; {\n      // Use parameter id if available, otherwise use array index\n      const console.log(&#96;📊 Initialized progress for parameter ${paramKey}: ${param.name}&#96;);\n    });\n    \n    return progress;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Set Socket.IO instance for real-time communication\n   */\n  setSocketIO(socketIO) {\n    this.socketIO = socketIO;\n    console.log('🔌 LHIS: SocketIO configured');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Set storage function for chat message persistence\n   */\n  setStorageFunction(emitAndStore) {\n    this.emitAndStore = emitAndStore;\n    console.log('💾 LHIS: Storage function configured');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Universal approach detection - works for all languages\n   */\n  detectApproachUniversal(code, language) {\n    if (!code || typeof code !== 'string' || code.trim().length === 0) {\n      console.log(&#96;⚠️ LHIS: No code provided for approach ${language} (${code.length} chars)&#96;);\n      const result = ApproachDetector.detectApproach(code, language);\n      console.log(&#96;✅ LHIS: Approach detected: ${result.type} (${(result.confidence confidence: 0, details: {}, problemType: 'general' };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Universal problem detection - works for all languages\n   */\n  detectProblemUniversal(code, language) {\n    if (!code || typeof code !== 'string' || code.trim().length === 0) {\n      console.log(&#96;⚠️ LHIS: No code provided for problem detection&#96;);\n      return { problemType: 'general_coding', problemId: 99, ProblemDetector.detectProblemType(code, language);\n      console.log(&#96;✅ LHIS: Problem detected: ${result.problemType} (ID: ${result.problemId})&#96;);\n      return result;\n    } catch (error) }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize parameter-based assessment session (for parameter selection sessions)\n   */\n  async initializeParameterAssessment(sessionId, userId, language, experienceLevel) {\n    try {\n      console.log(&#96;🎯 LHIS: Initializing parameter-based assessment for ${sessionId}&#96;);\n      \n      // Create a simplified session for parameter-based interviews\n      const session = {\n        sessionId,\n        userId,\n        language,\n        experienceLevel,\n        sessionStartTime: Date.now(), // Track start time for timer-based question forcing\n        currentProblemId: null, // DYNAMIC: Will be detected from code patterns\n        detectedApproach: null, // Will store detected approach\n        detectedProblemType: null, // Will store detected problem type\n        jobProfile: {\n          title: 'Dynamic Code Assessment',\n          parameters: [\n            {\n              id: 0,\n              name: 'Approach Analysis',\n              description: 'Analyze candidate approach and compare against alternatives'\n            }\n          ]\n        },\n        parameterProgress: {\n          0: {\n            milestone: 'not_started',\n            codeDetected: false,\n            questionsAsked: [],\n            approachDetected: false,\n            solutionsCompared: false\n          }\n        },\n        currentCode: { main: '' },\n        awaitingAnswer: null,\n        conversationThreads: new Map(),\n        conversationHistory: [],\n        conversationContext: {},\n        conversationNarrative: interests: new Set(),\n          concerns: new Set()\n        }\n      };\n      \n      this.activeSessions.set(sessionId, session);\n      console.log(&#96;✅ LHIS: Dynamic parameter-based session {\n      console.error(&#96;❌ LHIS: Parameter assessment initialization failed:&#96;, error);\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        error: error.message\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize assessment session with job profile\n   */\n  async initializeAssessment(sessionId, candidateId, jobProfileId, language, experienceLevel) {\n    try {\n      console.log(&#96;🎯 LHIS: Initializing assessment for session ${sessionId}&#96;);\n      \n      // Fetch job profile with better error handling\n      let jobProfile;\n      try {\n        const { data: jobProfiles, error:  }\n\n        if (jobProfiles.length &gt; 1) {\n          console.log(&#96;⚠️  Multiple job profiles found for ID ${jobProfileId}, using the first one&#96;);\n        }\n\n        jobProfile = const { data: existingSession } = await this.supabase\n        .from('assessment_sessions')\n        .select('*')\n        .eq('session_id', sessionId)\n        .single();\n\n      let assessmentSession;\n      if (existingSession) {\n        console.log(&#96;📋 Reusing existing assessment session for ${sessionId}&#96;);\n        assessmentSession = existingSession;\n      } else {\n        // Create new assessment session record\n        const { data: newSession, error: sessionError } = await this.supabase\n        .from('assessment_sessions')\n        .insert([{\n          session_id: sessionId,\n          candidate_id: candidateId,\n          job_profile_id: jobProfileId,\n          assessment_state: {\n            currentParameterIndex: 0,\n */\n  async monitorCodeChange(sessionId, questionId, code, language) {\n    const session = this.activeSessions.get(sessionId);\n    if (!session) {\n      console.log(&#96;⚠️ Session ${sessionId} not this.ensureSessionShapes(session);\n    if (!session || !code) {\n      return false; // Not enough code for analysis\n    }\n\n    // 🔧 CRITICAL FIX: Store the submitted code in session for question &amp;&amp; stats.meaningfulLines &lt; codeThresholds.minimumMeaningfulLines) return false;\n    if (qualityFilters &amp;&amp; typeof qualityFilters.maxBoilerplateRatio === 'number' &amp;&amp; stats.boilerplateRatio &gt; qualityFilters.maxBoilerplateRatio) return false;\n\n    const { jobProfile, parameterProgress } = session;\n    let newParameterDetected = false;\n\n    console.log(&#96;🔍 LHIS: Analyzing ${code.length} chars for parameter detection&#96;);\n    console.log(&#96;📊 LHIS: Available parameters: ${jobProfile.parameters?.length || 0}&#96;);\n    console.log(&#96;🔍 LHIS: Current parameterProgress state:&#96;, Object.keys(parameterProgress).map(key =&gt; &#96;${key}: codeDetected=${parameterProgress[key].codeDetected}&#96;));\n    \n    if (jobProfile.parameters) {\n      jobProfile.parameters.forEach((param, index) =&gt; {\n        console.log(&#96;   Parameter ${index + 1}: ${param.name} (ID: ${param.id})&#96;);\n      });\n    }\n\n    // SEQUENTIAL ANALYSIS: Check parameters in order, one at a time\n    // This prevents AI conflicts and ensures correct parameter detection\n    for (let i = 0; i &lt; (jobProfile.parameters || []).length; i++) {\n      const parameter = jobProfile.parameters[i];\n      const paramKey = parameter.id !== undefined ? parameter.id : i;\n      const progress = parameterProgress[paramKey];\n      \n      console.log(&#96;🔍 LHIS: Checking parameter ${parameter.name} (Key: ${paramKey})&#96;);\n      console.log(&#96;   Progress: codeDetected=${progress?.codeDetected}, questionsAsked=${progress?.questionsAsked?.length || 0}&#96;);\n      console.log(&#96;   Awaiting answer for: ${session.awaitingAnswer?.parameterId || 'none'}&#96;);\n      \n      // Skip if parameter already has questions or is being processed\n      if (progress?.codeDetected || session.awaitingAnswer?.parameterId == paramKey) {\n        console.log(&#96;   ⏭️ LHIS: Skipping ${parameter.name} - already detected or awaiting answer&#96;);\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // Skip if parameter is already completed\n      if (progress?.milestone === 'completed') {\n        console.log(&#96;   ⏭️ LHIS: Skipping ${parameter.name} - already completed&#96;);\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // Skip if parameter has already asked all 3 questions\n      if (progress?.questionsAsked &amp;&amp; progress.questionsAsked.length &gt;= 3) {\n        console.log(&#96;   ⏭️ LHIS: Skipping ${parameter.name} - all questions asked&#96;);\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // FLEXIBLE CHECK: Allow analyzing any undetected parameter\n      // This enables proper multi-parameter code analysis (e.g., AWS + DynamoDB code)\n      const isParameterUndetected = console.log(&#96;   ⏭️ LHIS: Skipping ${parameter.name} - already detected or completed&#96;);\n        continue;\n      }\n\n      // Use AI detection - trust the LLM to correctly identify parameters\n      console.log(&#96;   🔍 LHIS: Running AI detection for ${parameter.name}&#96;);\n      const isImplemented = await this.fastParameterDetection(code, parameter, language);\n      \n      if (isImplemented) {\n        console.log(&#96;✅ LHIS: Parameter ${parameter.name} detected in code&#96;);\n        progress.codeDetected = true;\n        progress.detectedAt = new detecting one parameter to prevent conflicts\n        break;\n      } else {\n        console.log(&#96;   ❌ LHIS: Parameter ${parameter.name} not detected yet&#96;);\n      }\n      \n      // Continue to next parameter if this one wasn't detected\n      // Only stop if we find a match to prevent conflicts\n    }\n\n    console.log(&#96;📝 LHIS: Analysis complete. New parameter detected: ${newParameterDetected}&#96;);\n    return newParameterDetected;\n  }\n\n\n\n  /**\n   * AI-powered parameter detection with specific criteria\n   * Enhanced to prevent cross-parameter detection confusion\n   */\n  async fastParameterDetection(code, parameter, language) {\n    console.log(&#96;🔍 Analyzing ${parameter.name}...&#96;);\n\n    try {\n      const aiService = require('./aiService');\n      \n      // Simple, clear prompt that trusts AI intelligence\n      const detectionPrompt = &#96;Analyze this ${language} code to determine if it demonstrates competency in \"${parameter.name}\".\n\nParameter: ${parameter.name}\nDescription: ${parameter.description}\n\nCODE:\n${code}\n\nInstructions:\n- Look at what the code actually implements and uses\n- Consider if this code demonstrates understanding of ${parameter.name}\n- Be precise - only detect what is clearly demonstrated in the code\n- Don't over-interpret or make assumptions\n\nRespond with JSON:\n{\n  \"detected\": true/false,\n  \"confidence\": 0-100,\n  \"evidence\": [\"specific elements in the code that demonstrate this parameter\"],\n  \"reasoning\": \"brief explanation of your assessment\"\n}&#96;;\n\n      console.log(&#96;🔍 Requesting AI analysis&#96;);\n      // Add timeout to prevent hanging\n      const response = await Promise.race([\n        aiService.performAIAnalysis(detectionPrompt),\n        new Promise((_, reject) =&gt; \n          setTimeout(() =&gt; reject(new Error('AI analysis timeout')), 10000) // 10 second timeout\n        )\n      ]);\n      \n      if (response) {\n      let result;\n        \n        // Parse the AI response - handle AI module's response format\n        try {\n          // Check if response has analysis field (from AI module)\n          if (response.analysis &amp;&amp; typeof response.analysis === 'object') {\n            result = response.analysis;\n          } else if (typeof response === 'string') {\n            // Try to extract JSON from string response\n            const jsonMatch = response.match(/\\{[\\s\\S]*\\}/);\n            if (jsonMatch) {\n              result = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]);\n            } else {\n              console.error('No JSON found in AI response');\n              return false;\n            }\n          } else if (typeof response === 'object') {\n            // Direct object response\n            result = response;\n      } else {\n            console.error('Unexpected response type:', typeof response);\n            return false;\n          }\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          console.error('Failed to parse AI response:', parseError);\n          return false;\n        }\n\n        // Validate the result has required fields\n        if (!result || typeof result.detected === 'undefined' || typeof result.confidence === 'undefined') {\n          console.error('Invalid AI response structure');\n          return false;\n        }\n\n        // Log the analysis result\n        console.log(&#96;🤖 ${parameter.name}: ${result.detected ? '✅' : '❌'} (${result.confidence}%) - ${result.reasoning}&#96;);\n\n        // Trust the AI with a reasonable confidence threshold\n        const isDetected = result.detected &amp;&amp; result.confidence &gt;= 70;\n        \n        return isDetected;\n      }\n      \n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error.message === 'AI analysis timeout') {\n        console.error(&#96;⏰ AI detection timeout for ${parameter.name} - falling back to false&#96;);\n      } else {\n      console.error(&#96;❌ AI detection error for ${parameter.name}:&#96;, error);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Default to not detected if AI fails or times out\n    return false;\n  }\n\n\n\n  /**\n   * Get objective detection criteria for a parameter\n   */\n  getObjectiveDetectionCriteria(parameter) {\n    const parameterName = parameter.name.toUpperCase();\n    \n    // AWS Services Proficiency\n    if (parameterName.includes('AWS')) {\n      return {\n        description: 'AWS Services Proficiency - Using AWS cloud services in the implementation',\n        primaryIndicators: [\n          'AWS SDK initialization or client creation (DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, etc.)',\n          'AWS service operations (put, get, query, upload, invoke)',\n          'Lambda function handler implementation',\n          'AWS resource configuration or setup',\n          'CloudFormation/CDK/SAM template usage'\n        ],\n        secondaryIndicators: [\n          'AWS environment variables (AWS_REGION, credentials)',\n          'IAM role or policy references',\n          'AWS resource ARNs in code',\n          'AWS-specific error handling',\n          'AWS service response handling'\n        ],\n        minimumPrimary: 1,\n        confidenceThreshold: 60\n      };\n    }\n    \n    // Java &amp; Spring Framework Expertise - ONLY trigger on Spring-specific indicators\n    if (parameterName.includes('SPRING')) {\n      return { \n        description: 'Java &amp; Spring Framework Expertise - Building Spring-based applications with EXPLICIT Spring annotations and features',\n        primaryIndicators: [\n          'Spring annotations (@SpringBootApplication, @RestController, @Service, @Component, @Repository)',\n          'Dependency injection (@Autowired, @Inject, @Bean configuration)',\n          'Spring REST endpoints (@GetMapping, @PostMapping, @RequestMapping, @PathVariable)',\n          'Spring Boot main class with SpringApplication.run()',\n          'Spring configuration (@Configuration, @EnableAutoConfiguration)'\n        ],\n        secondaryIndicators: [\n          'Spring profiles (@Profile, application.properties)',\n          'Spring transaction management (@Transactional)',\n          'Spring Data JPA repositories (extends JpaRepository)',\n          'Spring exception handling (@ExceptionHandler, @ControllerAdvice)',\n          'Spring Security configuration (@EnableWebSecurity)'\n        ],\n        minimumPrimary: 2,\n        confidenceThreshold: 85, // Increased from 70% to 85% for stricter detection\n        strictMode: true, // Add flag for extra strict validation\n        excludePatterns: [\n          'AWS DynamoDB mapper', \n          'AWS SDK', \n          'boto3', \n          'dynamo client',\n          'AWS services without Spring context'\n        ]\n      };\n    }\n    \n    // System Integration &amp; Data Management\n    if (parameterName.includes('SYSTEM') || parameterName.includes('DATA') || parameterName.includes('INTEGRATION')) {\n      return {\n        description: 'System Integration &amp; Data Management - +             return {
+                 "success": True,
+                 "response": result["content"],
+                 "provider": result.get("provider", provider),
+                 "model": result.get("model", AIConfig.MISTRAL_MODEL if provider == "mistral" else "codestral-2501"),
+                 "usage": result.get("usage", {})
+             }
+         else:
+             return {
+                 "success": False,
+                 "error": result.get("error", "Unknown error"),
+                 "provider": provider,
+                 "attempted_providers": result.get("attempted_providers", [])
+             }
+             
+     except Exception as e:
+         print(f"❌ Chat endpoint error: {e}")
+         return {
+             "success": False,
+             "error": str(e),
+             "provider": request.provider or "unknown"
+         }
+ 
  @app.get("/provider-status")
  async def get_provider_status():
```

+ #!/usr/bin/env python3
+ """
+ Test script for Mistral Devstral-2512 model
+ Tests the API connection and model response
+ """
+ 
+ import os
+ import sys
+ from dotenv import load_dotenv
+ from mistralai.client import MistralClient
+ 
+ # Load environment variables
+ load_dotenv()
+ 
+ def test_mistral_devstral():
+     """Test Mistral Devstral-2512 model connection and response."""
+     
+     # Get configuration
+     api_key = os.getenv("MISTRAL_API_KEY")
+     model = os.getenv("MISTRAL_MODEL", "devstral-2512")
+     
+     if not api_key:
+         print("❌ MISTRAL_API_KEY not found in .env file")
+         return False
+     
+     print(f"🔑 API Key: {api_key[:10]}...")
+     print(f"🤖 Model: {model}")
+     print(f"🌐 Endpoint: https://api.mistral.ai (default)")
+     print()
+     
+     try:
+         # Initialize Mistral client
+         print("🔌 Initializing Mistral client...")
+         client = MistralClient(api_key=api_key)
+         print("✅ Client initialized successfully")
+         print()
+         
+         # Test with a simple prompt
+         test_prompt = "Hello! Can you tell me what model you are and respond with a brief greeting?"
+         print(f"📤 Sending test prompt: {test_prompt}")
+         print()
+         
+         response = client.chat(
+             model=model,
+             messages=[{"role": "user", "content": test_prompt}],
+             temperature=0.7,
+             max_tokens=200
+         )
+         
+         # Extract response
+         content = response.choices[0].message.content
+         usage = response.usage
+         
+         print("✅ Response received successfully!")
+         print()
+         print("📥 Model Response:")
+         print("-" * 60)
+         print(content)
+         print("-" * 60)
+         print()
+         
+         if usage:
+             print("📊 Token Usage:")
+             print(f"   Prompt tokens: {usage.prompt_tokens}")
+             print(f"   Completion tokens: {usage.completion_tokens}")
+             print(f"   Total tokens: {usage.total_tokens}")
+             print()
+         
+         print("🎉 Mistral Devstral-2512 is working correctly!")
+         return True
+         
+     except Exception as e:
+         print(f"❌ Error: {e}")
+         print()
+         print("Error details:")
+         print(f"   Type: {type(e).__name__}")
+         print(f"   Message: {str(e)}")
+         return False
+ 
+ if __name__ == "__main__":
+     print("=" * 60)
+     print("🧪 Testing Mistral Devstral-2512 Model")
+     print("=" * 60)

+     if success:

+     else:

+         sys.exit(1)

+ /**
+  * Enhanced Debug Logger for Frontend Monitoring
+  * Provides comprehensive logging, error tracking, and debugging capabilities
+  */
+ 
+ type LogLevel = 'debug' | 'info' | 'warn' | 'error';
+ type LogCategory = 'socket' | 'api' | 'state' | 'ui' | 'code' | 'chat' | 'assessment' | 'general';
+ 
+ interface LogEntry {
+   timestamp: number;
+   level: LogLevel;
+   category: LogCategory;
+   message: string;
+   data?: any;
+   stack?: string;
+   url?: string;
+   userAgent?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ class DebugLogger {
+   private logs: LogEntry[] = [];
+   private maxLogs = 1000;
+   private enabled = process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' || 
+                    typeof window !== 'undefined' &amp;&amp; localStorage.getItem('debug_enabled') === 'true';
+   
+   private listeners: Set&lt;(entry: LogEntry) =&gt; void&gt; = new Set();
+ 
+   constructor() {
+     if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
+       // Expose to window for browser console access
+       (window as any).debugLogger = this;
+       
+       // Listen for unhandled errors
+       window.addEventListener('error', (event) =&gt; {
+         this.error('general', 'Unhandled Error', {
+           message: event.message,
+           filename: event.filename,
+           lineno: event.lineno,
+           colno: event.colno,
+           error: event.error
+         });
+       });
+ 
+       // Listen for unhandled promise rejections
+       window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (event) =&gt; {
+         this.error('general', 'Unhandled Promise Rejection', {
+           reason: event.reason,
+           error: event.reason instanceof Error ? event.reason.message : String(event.reason)
+         });
+       });
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Enable or disable logging
+    */
+   setEnabled(enabled: boolean) {
+     this.enabled = enabled;
+     if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
+       if (enabled) {
+         localStorage.setItem('debug_enabled', 'true');
+       } else {
+         localStorage.removeItem('debug_enabled');
+       }
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Add a log entry
+    */
+   private addLog(level: LogLevel, category: LogCategory, message: string, data?: any) {
+     if (!this.enabled &amp;&amp; level !== 'error') {
+       return;
+     }
+ 
+     const entry: LogEntry = {
+       timestamp: Date.now(),
+       level,
+       category,
+       message,
+       data: data ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data)) : undefined,
+       url: typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.href : undefined,
+       userAgent: typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.userAgent : undefined
+     };
+ 
+     if (data instanceof Error) {
+       entry.stack = data.stack;
+       entry.data = {
+         message: data.message,
+         name: data.name
+       };
+     }
+ 
+     this.logs.push(entry);
+     
+     // Keep only recent logs
+     if (this.logs.length &gt; this.maxLogs) {
+       this.logs.shift();
+     }
+ 
+     // Notify listeners
+     this.listeners.forEach(listener =&gt; listener(entry));
+ 
+     // Console output with styling
+     const emoji = this.getEmoji(level);
+     const style = this.getStyle(level);
+     const prefix = &#96;${emoji} [${category.toUpperCase()}]&#96;;
+     
+     if (typeof console !== 'undefined') {
+       if (level === 'error') {
+         console.error(prefix, message, data || '');
+       } else if (level === 'warn') {
+         console.warn(prefix, message, data || '');
+       } else if (level === 'debug') {
+         console.debug(prefix, message, data || '');
+       } else {
+         console.log(&#96;%c${prefix}&#96;, style, message, data || '');
+       }
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   private getEmoji(level: LogLevel): string {
+     switch (level) {
+       case 'error': return '❌';
+       case 'warn': return '⚠️';
+       case 'info': return 'ℹ️';
+       case 'debug': return '🔍';
+       default: return '📝';
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   private getStyle(level: LogLevel): string {
+     switch (level) {
+       case 'error': return 'color: red; font-weight: bold;';
+       case 'warn': return 'color: orange; font-weight: bold;';
+       case 'info': return 'color: blue;';
+       case 'debug': return 'color: gray;';
+       default: return '';
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Log methods
+    */
+   debug(category: LogCategory, message: string, data?: any) {
+     this.addLog('debug', category, message, data);
+   }
+ 
+   info(category: LogCategory, message: string, data?: any) {
+     this.addLog('info', category, message, data);
+   }
+ 
+   warn(category: LogCategory, message: string, data?: any) {
+     this.addLog('warn', category, message, data);
+   }
+ 
+   error(category: LogCategory, message: string, data?: any) {
+     this.addLog('error', category, message, data);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Log socket events
+    */
+   socket(event: string, data?: any, direction: 'in' | 'out' = 'in') {
+     const arrow = direction === 'in' ? '⬇️' : '⬆️';
+     this.debug('socket', &#96;${arrow} Socket: ${event}&#96;, data);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Log API requests
+    */
+   api(method: string, url: string, data?: any, response?: any, error?: any) {
+     if (error) {
+       this.error('api', &#96;${method} ${url}&#96;, { request: data, error });
+     } else {
+       this.info('api', &#96;${method} ${url}&#96;, { request: data, response });
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Log state changes
+    */
+   state(component: string, stateName: string, oldValue: any, newValue: any) {
+     this.debug('state', &#96;${component}: ${stateName}&#96;, { oldValue, newValue });
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Get all logs
+    */
+   getLogs(filter?: { level?: LogLevel; category?: LogCategory; limit?: number }): LogEntry[] {
+     let filtered = [...this.logs];
+ 
+     if (filter?.level) {
+       filtered = filtered.filter(log =&gt; log.level === filter.level);
+     }
+ 
+     if (filter?.category) {
+       filtered = filtered.filter(log =&gt; log.category === filter.category);
+     }
+ 
+     if (filter?.limit) {
+       filtered = filtered.slice(-filter.limit);
+     }
+ 
+     return filtered;
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Get logs as formatted string
+    */
+   getLogsAsString(filter?: { level?: LogLevel; category?: LogCategory; limit?: number }): string {
+     const logs = this.getLogs(filter);
+     return logs.map(log =&gt; {
+       const time = new Date(log.timestamp).toISOString();
+       return &#96;[${time}] [${log.level.toUpperCase()}] [${log.category}] ${log.message}${log.data ? ' ' + JSON.stringify(log.data, null, 2) : ''}&#96;;
+     }).join('\n');
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Clear logs
+    */
+   clear() {
+     this.logs = [];
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Export logs as JSON
+    */
+   exportLogs(): string {
+     return JSON.stringify(this.logs, null, 2);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Subscribe to log events
+    */
+   subscribe(listener: (entry: LogEntry) =&gt; void) {
+     this.listeners.add(listener);
+     return () =&gt; this.listeners.delete(listener);
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Get error summary
+    */
+   getErrorSummary(): { count: number; errors: LogEntry[] } {
+     const errors = this.logs.filter(log =&gt; log.level === 'error');
+     return {
+       count: errors.length,
+       errors: errors.slice(-10) // Last 10 errors
+     };
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ // Singleton instance
+ export const debugLogger = new DebugLogger();
+ 
+ // Convenience exports
+ export const log = {
+   debug: (category: LogCategory, message: string, data?: any) =&gt; debugLogger.debug(category, message, data),
+   info: (category: LogCategory, message: string, data?: any) =&gt; debugLogger.info(category, message, data),
+   warn: (category: LogCategory, message: string, data?: any) =&gt; debugLogger.warn(category, message, data),
+   error: (category: LogCategory, message: string, data?: any) =&gt; debugLogger.error(category, message, data),
+   socket: (event: string, data?: any, direction?: 'in' | 'out') =&gt; debugLogger.socket(event, data, direction),
+   api: (method: string, url: string, data?: any, response?: any, error?: any) =&gt; debugLogger.api(method, url, data, response, error),
+   state: (component: string, stateName: string, oldValue: any, newValue: any) =&gt; debugLogger.state(component, stateName, oldValue, newValue)
+ };
+ 
+ export default debugLogger;
+ 
```

</details>

</tool-use>

+ 'use client';
+ 
+ import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
+ import { X, Download, Trash2, Filter, AlertCircle, Info, AlertTriangle, Bug, Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';
+ import { Button } from './ui/button';
+ import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from './ui/card';
+ import { Badge } from './ui/badge';
+ import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from './ui/select';
+ import { ScrollArea } from './ui/scroll-area';
+ import { debugLogger, LogEntry, LogLevel, LogCategory } from '../lib/debug-logger';
+ 
+ interface DebugPanelProps {
+   onClose?: () =&gt; void;
+ }
+ 
+ export function DebugPanel({ onClose }: DebugPanelProps) {
+   const [logs, setLogs] = useState&lt;LogEntry[]&gt;([]);
+   const [filter, setFilter] = useState&lt;{ level?: LogLevel; category?: LogCategory }&gt;({});
+   const [autoScroll, setAutoScroll] = useState(true);
+   const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState(debugLogger.getLogs().length &gt; 0);
+   const scrollRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);
+   const endRef = useRef&lt;HTMLDivElement&gt;(null);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     // Load initial logs
+     updateLogs();
+ 
+     // Subscribe to new logs
+     const unsubscribe = debugLogger.subscribe(() =&gt; {
+       updateLogs();
+     });
+ 
+     return unsubscribe;
+   }, [filter]);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (autoScroll &amp;&amp; endRef.current) {
+       endRef.current.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
+     }
+   }, [logs, autoScroll]);
+ 
+   const updateLogs = () =&gt; {
+     const filteredLogs = debugLogger.getLogs(filter);
+     setLogs(filteredLogs);
+   };
+ 
+   const handleClear = () =&gt; {
+     debugLogger.clear();
+     updateLogs();
+   };
+ 
+   const handleExport = () =&gt; {
+     const data = debugLogger.exportLogs();
+     const blob = new Blob([data], { type: 'application/json' });
+     const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
+     const a = document.createElement('a');
+     a.href = url;
+     a.download = &#96;debug-logs-${new Date().toISOString()}.json&#96;;
+     a.click();
+     URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
+   };
+ 
+   const getLevelColor = (level: LogLevel) =&gt; {
+     switch (level) {
+       case 'error': return 'bg-red-500';
+       case 'warn': return 'bg-yellow-500';
+       case 'info': return 'bg-blue-500';
+       case 'debug': return 'bg-gray-500';
+       default: return 'bg-gray-400';
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const getLevelIcon = (level: LogLevel) =&gt; {
+     switch (level) {
+       case 'error': return &lt;AlertCircle className="h-3 w-3" /&gt;;
+       case 'warn': return &lt;AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" /&gt;;
+       case 'info': return &lt;Info className="h-3 w-3" /&gt;;
+       case 'debug': return &lt;Bug className="h-3 w-3" /&gt;;
+       default: return null;
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const errorSummary = debugLogger.getErrorSummary();
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;Card className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 w-[600px] max-h-[80vh] z-50 shadow-2xl"&gt;
+       &lt;CardHeader className="pb-3"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="flex items-center justify-between"&gt;
+           &lt;CardTitle className="text-lg flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+             &lt;Bug className="h-5 w-5" /&gt;
+             Debug Panel
+             {errorSummary.count &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;Badge variant="destructive" className="ml-2"&gt;
+                 {errorSummary.count} errors
+               &lt;/Badge&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/CardTitle&gt;
+           &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+             &lt;Button
+               variant="ghost"
+               size="sm"
+               onClick={() =&gt; {
+                 const newEnabled = !enabled;
+                 setEnabled(newEnabled);
+                 debugLogger.setEnabled(newEnabled);
+               }}
+               title={enabled ? 'Disable logging' : 'Enable logging'}
+             &gt;
+               {enabled ? &lt;Eye className="h-4 w-4" /&gt; : &lt;EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" /&gt;}
+             &lt;/Button&gt;
+             {onClose &amp;&amp; (
+               &lt;Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose}&gt;
+                 &lt;X className="h-4 w-4" /&gt;
+               &lt;/Button&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/CardHeader&gt;
+       &lt;CardContent className="p-0"&gt;
+         {/* Filters */}
+         &lt;div className="px-4 pb-3 flex gap-2"&gt;
+           &lt;Select
+             value={filter.level || 'all'}
+             onValueChange={(value) =&gt; setFilter({ ...filter, level: value === 'all' ? undefined : value as LogLevel })}
+           &gt;
+             &lt;SelectTrigger className="w-[120px]"&gt;
+               &lt;SelectValue placeholder="Level" /&gt;
+             &lt;/SelectTrigger&gt;
+             &lt;SelectContent&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="all"&gt;All Levels&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="error"&gt;Error&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="warn"&gt;Warn&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="info"&gt;Info&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="debug"&gt;Debug&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+             &lt;/SelectContent&gt;
+           &lt;/Select&gt;
+ 
+           &lt;Select
+             value={filter.category || 'all'}
+             onValueChange={(value) =&gt; setFilter({ ...filter, category: value === 'all' ? undefined : value as LogCategory })}
+           &gt;
+             &lt;SelectTrigger className="w-[140px]"&gt;
+               &lt;SelectValue placeholder="Category" /&gt;
+             &lt;/SelectTrigger&gt;
+             &lt;SelectContent&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="all"&gt;All Categories&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="socket"&gt;Socket&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="api"&gt;API&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="state"&gt;State&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="ui"&gt;UI&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="code"&gt;Code&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="chat"&gt;Chat&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="assessment"&gt;Assessment&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+               &lt;SelectItem value="general"&gt;General&lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+             &lt;/SelectContent&gt;
+           &lt;/Select&gt;
+ 
+           &lt;div className="flex-1" /&gt;
+ 
+           &lt;Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleClear}&gt;
+             &lt;Trash2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /&gt;
+             Clear
+           &lt;/Button&gt;
+           &lt;Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleExport}&gt;
+             &lt;Download className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /&gt;
+             Export
+           &lt;/Button&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+ 
+         {/* Logs */}
+         &lt;ScrollArea className="h-[400px] px-4"&gt;
+           &lt;div ref={scrollRef} className="space-y-1 pb-4"&gt;
+             {logs.length === 0 ? (
+               &lt;div className="text-center text-gray-500 py-8"&gt;
+                 No logs available
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             ) : (
+               logs.map((log, index) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;div

+ 'use client';
+ 
+ import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { Bug } from 'lucide-react';
+ import { Button } from './ui/button';
+ import { DebugPanel } from './debug-panel';
+ 
+ export function DebugToggle() {
+   const [showPanel, setShowPanel] = useState(false);
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     // Toggle with Ctrl+Shift+D (or Cmd+Shift+D on Mac)
+     const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) =&gt; {
+       if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) &amp;&amp; e.shiftKey &amp;&amp; e.key === 'D') {
+         e.preventDefault();
+         setShowPanel(prev =&gt; !prev);
+       }
+     };
+ 
+     window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
+     return () =&gt; window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
+   }, []);
+ 
+   // Check if debug mode is enabled in localStorage
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     const debugEnabled = localStorage.getItem('debug_enabled') === 'true';
+     if (debugEnabled &amp;&amp; typeof window !== 'undefined') {
+       // Auto-show panel if debug is enabled
+       setShowPanel(true);
+     }
+   }, []);
+ 
+   if (!showPanel) {
+     return (
+       &lt;Button
+         variant="outline"
+         size="sm"
+         onClick={() =&gt; setShowPanel(true)}
+         className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 shadow-lg"
+         title="Open Debug Panel (Ctrl+Shift+D)"
+       &gt;
+         &lt;Bug className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" /&gt;
+         Debug
+       &lt;/Button&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return &lt;DebugPanel onClose={() =&gt; setShowPanel(false)} /&gt;;
+ }
+ 
```

+ # Frontend Debugging Guide
+ 
+ ## Overview
+ 
+ This project includes a comprehensive debugging system to help monitor and diagnose frontend issues. The debug logger tracks all important events, errors, and state changes in the application.
+ 
+ ## Quick Start
+ 
+ ### Enable Debug Panel
+ 
+ 1. **Keyboard Shortcut**: Press &#96;Ctrl+Shift+D&#96; (or &#96;Cmd+Shift+D&#96; on Mac) to toggle the debug panel
+ 2. **Button**: Click the "Debug" button in the bottom-right corner
+ 3. **Auto-enable**: Set &#96;localStorage.setItem('debug_enabled', 'true')&#96; in browser console
+ 
+ ### Using the Debug Panel
+ 
+ The debug panel shows:
+ - **Real-time logs** with color-coded levels (Error, Warn, Info, Debug)
+ - **Filtering** by level and category
+ - **Export** logs as JSON
+ - **Error summary** with count and recent errors
+ - **Auto-scroll** to latest logs
+ 
+ ## Log Categories
+ 
+ - &#96;socket&#96; - Socket.io events (connect, disconnect, messages)
+ - &#96;api&#96; - HTTP API requests and responses
+ - &#96;state&#96; - React state changes
+ - &#96;ui&#96; - UI interactions and events
+ - &#96;code&#96; - Code execution and editor events
+ - &#96;chat&#96; - Chat messages and events
+ - &#96;assessment&#96; - Assessment/LHIS related events
+ - &#96;general&#96; - General application events
+ 
+ ## Usage Examples
+ 
+ ### Basic Logging
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { log } from '@/lib/debug-logger';
+ 
+ // Info log
+ log.info('api', 'Fetching user data', { userId: 123 });
+ 
+ // Error log
+ log.error('socket', 'Connection failed', error);
+ 
+ // Debug log
+ log.debug('state', 'User logged in', { userId: 123 });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Socket Events
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // Log incoming socket event
+ log.socket('newMessage', messageData, 'in');
+ 
+ // Log outgoing socket event
+ log.socket('sendMessage', messageData, 'out');
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### API Requests
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ try {
+   log.api('POST', '/api/users', requestData);
+   const response = await fetch('/api/users', options);
+   const data = await response.json();
+   log.api('POST', '/api/users', requestData, data);
+ } catch (error) {
+   log.api('POST', '/api/users', requestData, null, error);
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### State Changes
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
+ 
+ useEffect(() =&gt; {
+   log.state('Counter', 'count', count - 1, count);
+ }, [count]);
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Browser Console Access
+ 
+ The debug logger is also exposed to the browser console:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;javascript
+ // Access logger in browser console
+ window.debugLogger
+ 
+ // Get all logs
+ window.debugLogger.getLogs()
+ 
+ // Get errors only
+ window.debugLogger.getLogs({ level: 'error' })
+ 
+ // Get socket logs only
+ window.debugLogger.getLogs({ category: 'socket' })
+ 
+ // Get last 50 logs
+ window.debugLogger.getLogs({ limit: 50 })
+ 
+ // Export logs
+ window.debugLogger.exportLogs()
+ 
+ // Clear logs
+ window.debugLogger.clear()
+ 
+ // Enable/disable logging
+ window.debugLogger.setEnabled(true)
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Common Debugging Scenarios
+ 
+ ### 1. Socket Connection Issues
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // In your socket setup
+ socket.on('connect', () =&gt; {
+   log.socket('connect', { roomId }, 'in');
+ });
+ 
+ socket.on('disconnect', () =&gt; {
+   log.socket('disconnect', {}, 'in');
+ });
+ 
+ socket.on('error', (error) =&gt; {
+   log.error('socket', 'Socket error', error);
+ });
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 2. API Request Failures
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ const fetchData = async () =&gt; {
+   try {
+     log.api('GET', '/api/data');
+     const response = await fetch('/api/data');
+     
+     if (!response.ok) {
+       throw new Error(&#96;HTTP ${response.status}&#96;);
+     }
+     
+     const data = await response.json();
+     log.api('GET', '/api/data', null, data);
+     return data;
+   } catch (error) {
+     log.error('api', 'Failed to fetch data', error);
+     throw error;
+   }
+ };
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 3. State Debugging
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ // Track state changes
+ useEffect(() =&gt; {
+   log.state('ComponentName', 'stateName', previousValue, currentValue);
+ }, [stateName]);
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### 4. Component Lifecycle
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ useEffect(() =&gt; {
+   log.debug('ui', 'Component mounted', { componentName: 'MyComponent' });
+   
+   return () =&gt; {
+     log.debug('ui', 'Component unmounted', { componentName: 'MyComponent' });
+   };
+ }, []);
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Exporting Logs for Analysis
+ 
+ 1. Click "Export" in the debug panel
+ 2. Or use browser console: &#96;window.debugLogger.exportLogs()&#96;
+ 3. Share the JSON file for analysis
+ 
+ ## Tips
+ 
+ 1. **Filter by category** to focus on specific areas (e.g., only socket events)
+ 2. **Filter by level** to see only errors or warnings
+ 3. **Use auto-scroll** to follow real-time events
+ 4. **Export logs** before clearing to preserve debugging session
+ 5. **Enable logging early** in development to catch issues
+ 
+ ## Performance
+ 
+ - Logs are limited to 1000 entries (oldest are removed)
+ - Logging is disabled in production by default
+ - Enable with &#96;localStorage.setItem('debug_enabled', 'true')&#96; if needed
+ 
+ ## Integration Points
+ 
+ The logger is already integrated in:
+ - &#96;app/room/[id]/page.tsx&#96; - Socket events and API calls
+ - More integrations can be added as needed
+ 
+ To add logging to a new component:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ import { log } from '@/lib/debug-logger';
+ 
+ // Add logging where needed
+ log.info('category', 'message', data);
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
```

Created a debugging system for the frontend. Summary:

## What I've created

### 1. Debug logger (`frontend/lib/debug-logger.ts`)
- Logs errors, warnings, info, and debug messages
- Categorizes logs (socket, API, state, UI, code, chat, assessment, general)
- Tracks unhandled errors and promise rejections
- Stores up to 1000 logs with automatic cleanup
- Exposes `window.debugLogger` for browser console access

### 2. Debug panel (`frontend/components/debug-panel.tsx`)
- Real-time log viewer with color-coded levels
- Filter by level (error, warn, info, debug) and category
- Export logs as JSON
- Error summary with counts
- Auto-scroll to latest logs

### 3. Debug toggle (`frontend/components/debug-toggle.tsx`)
- Toggle with `Ctrl+Shift+D` (or `Cmd+Shift+D` on Mac)
- Button in bottom-right corner
- Auto-shows if debug is enabled in localStorage

### 4. Integration
- Added to main layout (development mode only)
- Example logging in room page for socket and API events

## How to use

### Quick start
1. Press `Ctrl+Shift+D` (or `Cmd+Shift+D` on Mac) to open the debug panel
2. Or click the "Debug" button in the bottom-right corner
3. View real-time logs with filtering and export

### In browser console
```javascript
// Get all logs
window.debugLogger.getLogs()

// Get only errors
window.debugLogger.getLogs({ level: 'error' })

// Get socket events
window.debugLogger.getLogs({ category: 'socket' })

// Export logs
window.debugLogger.exportLogs()

// Clear logs
window.debugLogger.clear()
`
